#the final output of this code is the hcmd.rds file with standardized cause of death information for each decedent record. 

#this final output is achieved by fitting decedent records into a template that is to be read by a keyword-matching algorithm that then assigns each record to standdardized COD outputs
```{r libraries and data}
#loading R and python packages
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(reticulate)
py_require("pandas")
py_require("numpy")
py_require("openpyxl")
py_require("rapidfuzz")

#reading in the template 
template<-read_xlsx("code/b_01_COD Coding Input template.xlsx")

#reading in the decedent data
combined <- readRDS("data/a_02_mortality_data_post_processed/combined_mortality_data.rds")

```

#this step explores patterns of missingness in the mortality records
```{r counting}
#checking string type of general and specific causes of death
str(combined$cause_general) #character
str(combined$illspec) #character

#turning blank and NaN entries into NA entries to understand missingness
combined <- combined %>%mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(., "")))
combined <- combined %>%mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(., "NaN")))

#counting how many entries have NA cause_general information (n=7688 in September 2026 data set)
combined%>%filter(is.na(cause_general))%>%count() 


#counting how many entries have NA cause specific information (n=14,214 in September 2026 data set)
combined %>%
  filter(
    (is.na(illspec)) &

  filter(
    (!is.na(cause_general))|

    (!is.na(drugspec)) |
    (!is.na(selfspec)) |

  ) %>%
  count() 


```


#fitting data into template 
```{r fitting}
#template has two columns, "case_number" and "cause"
#template column "cause" concatenates both general and specific cause information from input data set

template1 <- combined %>%
  transmute(
    CASE_NUMBER = case_number,
    CAUSE = paste(
      cause_general,
      coalesce(
        illspec,
        drugspec,
        homispec,
        suicspec,
        selfspec,
        accspec,
        otherspec,
        cause_specific
      ),
      sep = ": "
    )
  )

#checking to make sure missingness pattern matches combined data set 
template1%>%filter(is.na(CAUSE))%>%count() #0
template1%>%count(CAUSE, sort= TRUE)
template1$CAUSE[template1$CAUSE == "NA: NA"]<-NA 
template1%>%filter(!is.na(CAUSE))%>%count() #this value should match the number of entries have non-NA cause specific and/or cause_general information in your original dataset


#cleaning template to shorten cause_general SUICIDE description 
template1 %>%count(CAUSE, sort = TRUE)

template1$CAUSE <- sub(
  "^Suicide.*?:",
  "Suicide:",
  template1$CAUSE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

#cleaning template to shorten cause_general AIDS-related illness description 
template1$CAUSE <- sub(
  "^Illness.*?:",
  "Illness:",
  template1$CAUSE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)


#saving template into archived folder to be used in algorithm
write_xlsx(template1, "code/cod_algorithm_extras/z_archived/COD Coding Input template_1.xlsx")
```

#putting template through an algorithm (in python) that assigns standardized COD output
```{python levelsmatch}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from rapidfuzz import fuzz
import re


#loading template
excel_file_name = "code/cod_algorithm_extras/z_archived/COD Coding Input template_1.xlsx"
sub_sheet = "Sheet1"

#loading keyword lexicon 
keywords_excel = "code/b_00_final_kw_v1.xlsx"
kw_sub_sheet = "kw_icd_categories"

#keywords are matched with 85% similarity 
FUZZY_THRESHOLD = 85


#configuring data

df = pd.read_excel(
    excel_file_name,
    sheet_name=sub_sheet,
    engine="openpyxl"
)

df["CAUSE"] = (
    df["CAUSE"]
    .fillna("")
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
    .str.upper()
)


#configuring keywords

kw_df = pd.read_excel(
    keywords_excel,
    sheet_name=kw_sub_sheet,
    engine="openpyxl"
)


def clean(col):
    return (
        kw_df[col]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .str.upper()
        .str.strip()
        .tolist()
    )


od_keywords = clean("OVERDOSE KEYWORDS")
cold_keywords = clean("COLD KEYWORDS")
heat_keywords = clean("HEAT KEYWORDS")
suicide_keywords = clean("SUICIDE KEYWORDS")
homicide_keywords = clean("HOMICIDE KEYWORDS")
cardio_keywords = clean("CARDIOVASCULAR KEYWORDS")
resp_keywords = clean("RESPIRATORY KEYWORDS")
ca_keywords = clean("CANCERS KEYWORDS")
neuro_keywords = clean("NEUROPSYCHIATRIC KEYWORDS")
covid_keywords = clean("COVID-19 KEYWORDS")
comm_keywords = clean("COMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS")
non_comm_keywords = clean("NONCOMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS")
acc_keywords = clean("ACCIDENTAL KEYWORDS")
external_keywords = clean("INJURY KEYWORDS")
internal_keywords = clean("INTERNAL KEYWORDS")
unk_keywords = clean("UNDETERMINED")
dig_keywords = clean("DIGESTIVE KEYWORDS")
gen_keywords = clean("GENITOUTINARY KEYWORDS")
meta_keywords = clean("ENDROCRINE, NUTRITIONAL, AND METABOLIC DISEASE  KEYWORDS")


#flagging categories for binary output

flags = [
    "OVERDOSE",
    "COLD",
    "HEAT",
    "SUICIDE",
    "HOMICIDE",
    "CARDIOVASCULAR",
    "RESPIRATORY",
    "CANCER",
    "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC",
    "COVID",
    "COMM_DISEASE",
    "NON_COMM_DISEASE",
    "ACCIDENTAL",
    "UNDETERMINED",
    "EXTERNAL",
    "INTERNAL"
    "DIGESTIVE",
    "GENITOUTINARY",
    "ENDOCRINE, NUTRITIONAL, AND METABOLIC DISEASE"
]

for f in flags:
    df[f] = False


#assigning cause groups 
cause_groups = {
    "OVERDOSE": od_keywords,
    "COLD": cold_keywords,
    "HEAT": heat_keywords,
    "SUICIDE": suicide_keywords,
    "HOMICIDE": homicide_keywords,
    "CARDIOVASCULAR": cardio_keywords,
    "RESPIRATORY": resp_keywords,
    "CANCER": ca_keywords,
    "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC": neuro_keywords,
    "COVID": covid_keywords,
    "COMM_DISEASE": comm_keywords,
    "NON_COMM_DISEASE": non_comm_keywords,
    "ACCIDENTAL": acc_keywords,
    "EXTERNAL": external_keywords,
    "INTERNAL": internal_keywords,
    "UNDETERMINED": unk_keywords,
    "DIGESTIVE": dig_keywords,
    "GENITOUTINARY": gen_keywords,
    "ENDROCRINE, NUTRITIONAL, AND METABOLIC DISEASE  KEYWORDS": meta_keywords
}


# creating match_count, match_keywords and levela and levelb categories for class_level_3 

#level3 potential groups (most specific possible COD classifications)

level3_groups = {
    "COLD": cold_keywords,
    "HEAT": heat_keywords,
    "OVERDOSE": od_keywords,
    "ACCIDENTAL": acc_keywords,
    "SUICIDE": suicide_keywords,
    "HOMICIDE": homicide_keywords,
    "COVID": covid_keywords,
    "COMM_DISEASE": comm_keywords,
    "CANCER": ca_keywords,
    "CARDIOVASCULAR": cardio_keywords,
    "RESPIRATORY": resp_keywords,
    "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC": neuro_keywords,
    "NON_COMM_DISEASE": non_comm_keywords,
    "DIGESTIVE": dig_keywords,
    "GENITOUTINARY": gen_keywords,
    "ENDROCRINE, NUTRITIONAL, AND METABOLIC DISEASE": meta_keywords
}


#level3 labels 

class3_labels = {
    "COLD": "Cold-related death",
    "HEAT": "Heat-related death",
    "OVERDOSE": "Overdose",
    "ACCIDENTAL": "Other Accidental",
    "SUICIDE": "Suicide",
    "HOMICIDE": "Homicide",
    "COVID": "COVID-19",
    "COMM_DISEASE": "Other Communicable Disease",
    "CANCER": "Cancer",
    "CARDIOVASCULAR": "Cardiovascular Disease",
    "RESPIRATORY": "Respiratory Disease",
    "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC": "Neuropsychiatric Conditions",
    "NON_COMM_DISEASE": "Other Non-Communicable Disease"
    "DIGESTIVE": "Digestive Disease"
    "GENITOUTINARY": "Genitoutinary Disease"
    "ENDROCRINE, NUTRITIONAL, AND METABOLIC DISEASE  KEYWORDS": "Endocrine, Nutritional, or Metabolic Disease" 
}


#replicating match tracking process
df["MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = ""
df["MATCH_SCORE"] = np.nan
df["MATCH_TYPE"] = ""


#and adding additional match categories specific to level3
df["MATCH_COUNT"] = 0 #how many matches were made
df["MATCHED_KEYWORDS"] = "" #which words were matched
df["CLASS_LEVEL_3_A"] = "" #captures the first possible match in level3
df["CLASS_LEVEL_3_B"] = "" #captures other level3 matches


#classification matching logic first reads for exact matches

for flag, kws in cause_groups.items():



    for kw in kws:

        mask = (
            df["CAUSE"]
            .str.contains(
                rf"\b{re.escape(kw)}\b",
                na=False,
                regex=True
            )
        )

        df.loc[mask, flag] = True


#and then falls back to fuzzy match (.85 str distance) if no exact match is made

    mask = (
        (df[flag] == False) &
        (df["CAUSE"] != "")
    )


    for idx, text in df.loc[
        mask,
        "CAUSE"
    ].items():is 

        best_kw = None
        best_score = 0

        for kw in kws:

            score = fuzz.token_set_ratio(
                text,
                kw
            )

            if score > best_score:
                best_score = score
                best_kw = kw


        if best_score >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD:

            df.loc[idx, flag] = True


# searching for level3 matches, matches are ordered by where the keyword first appears in the original CAUSE text.


for idx, text in df["CAUSE"].items():

    if text == "":
        continue


    level3_matches = []



    for flag, kws in level3_groups.items():

        exact_matches_for_group = []


        # exact matches

        for kw in kws:

            match = re.search(
                rf"\b{re.escape(kw)}\b",
                text
            )

            if match:

                exact_matches_for_group.append({
                    "keyword": kw,
                    "flag": flag,
                    "score": 100,
                    "type": "Exact",
                    "position": match.start()
                })


        level3_matches.extend(
            exact_matches_for_group
        )


        #fuzzy matches 

        if len(exact_matches_for_group) == 0:

            best_kw = None
            best_score = 0

            for kw in kws:

                score = fuzz.token_set_ratio(
                    text,
                    kw
                )

                if score > best_score:

                    best_score = score
                    best_kw = kw


            if best_score >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD:

                level3_matches.append({
                    "keyword": best_kw,
                    "flag": flag,
                    "score": best_score,
                    "type": "Fuzzy",
                    "position": float("inf")
                })


    # removing duplicate keywords


    unique_matches = {}


    for match in level3_matches:

        keyword = match["keyword"]


        if keyword not in unique_matches:

            unique_matches[keyword] = match

        elif match["position"] < unique_matches[keyword]["position"]:

            unique_matches[keyword] = match


    # sorting by whatever comes first in the text

    level3_matches = sorted(
        unique_matches.values(),
        key=lambda x: x["position"]
    )


    # counting if no level3 matches

    if len(level3_matches) == 0:
        continue


    # building match count

    df.loc[idx, "MATCH_COUNT"] = len(
        level3_matches
    )


    # building matched keywords

    matched_keywords = [
        match["keyword"]
        for match in level3_matches
    ]

    df.loc[idx, "MATCHED_KEYWORDS"] = (
        " | ".join(matched_keywords)
    )


    # level3a

    primary = level3_matches[0]

    df.loc[idx, "CLASS_LEVEL_3_A"] = (
        class3_labels[primary["flag"]]
    )


    # level3b

    secondary = level3_matches[1:]


    if len(secondary) > 0:

        secondary_classes = [
            class3_labels[match["flag"]]
            for match in secondary
        ]


        # removing any duplicates

        secondary_classes = list(
            dict.fromkeys(secondary_classes)
        )


        df.loc[idx, "CLASS_LEVEL_3_B"] = (
            " | ".join(secondary_classes)
        )


    # building match categories

    df.loc[idx, "MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = (
        primary["keyword"]
    )

    df.loc[idx, "MATCH_SCORE"] = (
        primary["score"]
    )

    df.loc[idx, "MATCH_TYPE"] = (
        primary["type"]
    )


# building tiered categories

df["NON_COMM_DISEASE"] = (
    df["FNON_COMM_DISEASE"] |
    df["CARDIOVASCULAR"] |
    df["RESPIRATORY"] |
    df["CANCER"] |
    df["NEUROPSYCHIATRIC"] |
    df["DIGESTIVE"] |
    df["GENITOUTINARY"] |
    df["ENDROCRINE, NUTRITIONAL, AND METABOLIC DISEASE"]
)


df["COMM_DISEASE"] = (
    df["COMM_DISEASE"] |
    df["COVID"]
)


df["ACCIDENTAL"] = (
    df["ACCIDENTAL"] |
    df["OVERDOSE"] |
    df["COLD"] |
    df["HEAT"]
)


df["INTENTIONAL"] = (
    df["SUICIDE"] |
    df["HOMICIDE"]
)


df["EXTERNAL"] = (
    df["EXTERNAL"] |
    df["ACCIDENTAL"] |
    df["INTENTIONAL"]
)


df["INTERNAL"] = (
    df["INTERNAL"] |
    df["COMM_DISEASE"] |
    df["NON_COMM_DISEASE"]
)


# building undetermined category 

specific_cause_cols = [
    "COMM_DISEASE",
    "NON_COMM_DISEASE",
    "EXTERNAL",
    "ACCIDENTAL",
    "SUICIDE",
    "HOMICIDE",
    "OVERDOSE",
    "COLD",
    "HEAT",
    "CARDIOVASCULAR",
    "RESPIRATORY",
    "CANCER",
    "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC",
    "COVID",
    "DIGESTIVE",
    "GENITOUTINARY",
    "ENDROCRINE, NUTRITIONAL, AND METABOLIC DISEASE"
]


df["UNDETERMINED"] = (
    df["UNDETERMINED"] |
    ~df[specific_cause_cols]
        .fillna(False)
        .any(axis=1)
)



# building level1
def get_level1(row):

    if row["EXTERNAL"]:
        return "External/Injury (Unnatural Death)"

    if row["INTERNAL"]:
        return "Internal (Natural Death)"

    if row["UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "Undetermined"

    return "Undetermined"


# building level2

def get_level2(row):

    if row["ACCIDENTAL"]:
        return "Accidental"

    if row["INTENTIONAL"]:
        return "Intentional"

    if row["COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Communicable Disease"

    if row["NON_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Non-Communicable Disease"

    if row["UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "Undetermined"

    return "Undetermined"


# building level3

def get_level3(row):

    # accidental

    if row["COLD"]:
        return "Cold-related death"

    if row["HEAT"]:
        return "Heat-related death"

    if row["OVERDOSE"]:
        return "Overdose"

    if row["ACCIDENTAL"]:
        return "Other Accidental"


    # intentional

    if row["SUICIDE"]:
        return "Suicide"

    if row["HOMICIDE"]:
        return "Homicide"


    # communicable

    if row["COVID"]:
        return "COVID-19"

    if row["COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Other Communicable Disease"


    # non-communicable

    if row["CANCER"]:
        return "Cancer"

    if row["CARDIOVASCULAR"]:
        return "Cardiovascular Disease"

    if row["RESPIRATORY"]:
        return "Respiratory Disease"

    if row["NEUROPSYCHIATRIC"]:
        return "Neuropsychiatric Conditions"

    if row["NON_COMM_DISEASE"]:
        return "Other Non-Communicable Disease"


    # undetermined

    if row["UNDETERMINED"]:
        return "Undetermined"

    return "Undetermined"


df["CLASS_LEVEL_1"] = df.apply(
    get_level1,
    axis=1
)

df["CLASS_LEVEL_2"] = df.apply(
    get_level2,
    axis=1
)


#export

df.to_excel(
    "code/cod_algorithm_extras/b_01_full_results_ICD.xlsx",
    index=False
)
```

#testing with multiple level 2
```{python levels}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from rapidfuzz import fuzz
import re


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CONFIG
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

excel_file_name = "code/cod_algorithm_extras/z_archived/COD Coding Input template_1.xlsx"
sub_sheet = "Sheet1"

keywords_excel = "code/b_00_final_kw_v1.xlsx"
kw_sub_sheet = "kw_icd_categories"

FUZZY_THRESHOLD = 85


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD DATA
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

df = pd.read_excel(
    excel_file_name,
    sheet_name=sub_sheet,
    engine="openpyxl"
)

df["CAUSE"] = (
    df["CAUSE"]
    .fillna("")
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
    .str.upper()
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD KEYWORDS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

kw_df = pd.read_excel(
    keywords_excel,
    sheet_name=kw_sub_sheet,
    engine="openpyxl"
)


def clean(col):
    return (
        kw_df[col]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .str.upper()
        .str.strip()
        .tolist()
    )


od_keywords = clean("OVERDOSE KEYWORDS")
cold_keywords = clean("COLD KEYWORDS")
heat_keywords = clean("HEAT KEYWORDS")
suicide_keywords = clean("SUICIDE KEYWORDS")
homicide_keywords = clean("HOMICIDE KEYWORDS")
cardio_keywords = clean("CARDIOVASCULAR KEYWORDS")
resp_keywords = clean("RESPIRATORY KEYWORDS")
ca_keywords = clean("CANCERS KEYWORDS")
neuro_keywords = clean("NEUROPSYCHIATRIC KEYWORDS")
covid_keywords = clean("COVID-19 KEYWORDS")
comm_keywords = clean("COMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS")
non_comm_keywords = clean("NONCOMMUNICABLE DISEASE KEYWORDS")
acc_keywords = clean("ACCIDENTAL KEYWORDS")

# NOTE: external_keywords / internal_keywords / unk_keywords are no longer
# used for matching. Previously they fed a separate EXTERNAL/INTERNAL/
# UNDETERMINED keyword pass that could disagree with the Level 1 value
# derived from the Level 2/3 hierarchy. Level 1 is now derived entirely
# from the hierarchy below, so there is a single source of truth. If you
# still want a broad EXTERNAL/INTERNAL keyword pass as an independent
# sanity check (not feeding into CLASS_LEVEL_1), let me know and we can
# add it back as a separate diagnostic column.


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HIERARCHY DEFINITIONS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# level3 flag -> list of keywords used to detect that flag
level3_groups = {
    "COLD": cold_keywords,
    "HEAT": heat_keywords,
    "OVERDOSE": od_keywords,
    "ACCIDENTAL": acc_keywords,
    "SUICIDE": suicide_keywords,
    "HOMICIDE": homicide_keywords,
    "COVID": covid_keywords,
    "COMM_DISEASE": comm_keywords,
    "CANCER": ca_keywords,
    "CARDIOVASCULAR": cardio_keywords,
    "RESPIRATORY": resp_keywords,
    "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC": neuro_keywords,
    "NON_COMM_DISEASE": non_comm_keywords
}

# level3 flag -> readable label
class3_labels = {
    "COLD": "Cold-related death",
    "HEAT": "Heat-related death",
    "OVERDOSE": "Overdose",
    "ACCIDENTAL": "Other Accidental",
    "SUICIDE": "Suicide",
    "HOMICIDE": "Homicide",
    "COVID": "COVID-19",
    "COMM_DISEASE": "Other Communicable Disease",
    "CANCER": "Cancer",
    "CARDIOVASCULAR": "Cardiovascular Disease",
    "RESPIRATORY": "Respiratory Disease",
    "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC": "Neuropsychiatric Conditions",
    "NON_COMM_DISEASE": "Other Non-Communicable Disease"
}

# level3 flag -> level2 parent label
level2_parent = {
    "COLD": "Accidental",
    "HEAT": "Accidental",
    "OVERDOSE": "Accidental",
    "ACCIDENTAL": "Accidental",
    "SUICIDE": "Intentional",
    "HOMICIDE": "Intentional",
    "COVID": "Communicable Disease",
    "COMM_DISEASE": "Communicable Disease",
    "CANCER": "Non-Communicable Disease",
    "CARDIOVASCULAR": "Non-Communicable Disease",
    "RESPIRATORY": "Non-Communicable Disease",
    "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC": "Non-Communicable Disease",
    "NON_COMM_DISEASE": "Non-Communicable Disease",
}

# level2 label -> level1 parent label
level1_parent = {
    "Accidental": "External/Injury (Unnatural Death)",
    "Intentional": "External/Injury (Unnatural Death)",
    "Communicable Disease": "Internal (Natural Death)",
    "Non-Communicable Disease": "Internal (Natural Death)",
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# INITIALIZE OUTPUT COLUMNS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

df["MATCH_COUNT"] = 0
df["MATCHED_KEYWORDS"] = ""
df["MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = ""
df["MATCH_SCORE"] = np.nan
df["MATCH_TYPE"] = ""

# level3/level2 grouped into up to two slots (A, B) based on shared level2 parent 
# level3 match.
df["CLASS_LEVEL_3_A"] = ""
df["CLASS_LEVEL_2_A"] = ""
df["CLASS_LEVEL_3_B"] = ""
df["CLASS_LEVEL_2_B"] = ""
df["LEVEL2_GROUP_COUNT"] = 0
df["LEVEL2_OVERFLOW"] = ""

#class level 1 remains as a single option 

df["CLASS_LEVEL_1"] = ""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAIN MATCHING LOOP
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

for idx, text in df["CAUSE"].items():

    if text == "":
        continue

    level3_matches = []

    for flag, kws in level3_groups.items():

        exact_matches_for_group = []

        # exact matches
        for kw in kws:
            match = re.search(
                rf"\b{re.escape(kw)}\b",
                text
            )
            if match:
                exact_matches_for_group.append({
                    "keyword": kw,
                    "flag": flag,
                    "score": 100,
                    "type": "Exact",
                    "position": match.start()
                })

        level3_matches.extend(exact_matches_for_group)

        # fuzzy fallback, only if no exact match for this flag
        if len(exact_matches_for_group) == 0:

            best_kw = None
            best_score = 0

            for kw in kws:
                score = fuzz.token_set_ratio(text, kw)
                if score > best_score:
                    best_score = score
                    best_kw = kw

            if best_score >= FUZZY_THRESHOLD:
                level3_matches.append({
                    "keyword": best_kw,
                    "flag": flag,
                    "score": best_score,
                    "type": "Fuzzy",
                    "position": float("inf")
                })

    # remove duplicate keywords, keeping the earliest position seen
    unique_matches = {}
    for match in level3_matches:
        keyword = match["keyword"]
        if keyword not in unique_matches:
            unique_matches[keyword] = match
        elif match["position"] < unique_matches[keyword]["position"]:
            unique_matches[keyword] = match

    # sort by where each match first appears in the text
    level3_matches = sorted(
        unique_matches.values(),
        key=lambda x: x["position"]
    )

    if len(level3_matches) == 0:
        continue

    # match diagnostics
    df.loc[idx, "MATCH_COUNT"] = len(level3_matches)
    df.loc[idx, "MATCHED_KEYWORDS"] = " | ".join(
        match["keyword"] for match in level3_matches
    )

    primary = level3_matches[0]
    df.loc[idx, "MATCHED_KEYWORD"] = primary["keyword"]
    df.loc[idx, "MATCH_SCORE"] = primary["score"]
    df.loc[idx, "MATCH_TYPE"] = primary["type"]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # group level3 matches by their level2 parent, preserving order of
    # first appearance of each parent group in the text
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    groups = {}       # level2 parent -> ordered, deduped list of level3 labels
    group_order = []  # order in which parents first appear

    for match in level3_matches:
        label3 = class3_labels[match["flag"]]
        parent2 = level2_parent[match["flag"]]

        if parent2 not in groups:
            groups[parent2] = []
            group_order.append(parent2)

        if label3 not in groups[parent2]:
            groups[parent2].append(label3)

    df.loc[idx, "LEVEL2_GROUP_COUNT"] = len(group_order)

    if len(group_order) >= 1:
        parent_a = group_order[0]
        df.loc[idx, "CLASS_LEVEL_2_A"] = parent_a
        df.loc[idx, "CLASS_LEVEL_3_A"] = " | ".join(groups[parent_a])

    if len(group_order) >= 2:
        parent_b = group_order[1]
        df.loc[idx, "CLASS_LEVEL_2_B"] = parent_b
        df.loc[idx, "CLASS_LEVEL_3_B"] = " | ".join(groups[parent_b])

    if len(group_order) >= 3:
        overflow_parents = group_order[2:]
        overflow_labels = [
            f"{p}: {' | '.join(groups[p])}" for p in overflow_parents
        ]
        df.loc[idx, "LEVEL2_OVERFLOW"] = " ; ".join(overflow_labels)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # level1: independent dedup across whichever level2 groups appear
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    level1_labels = []
    for parent2 in group_order:
        parent1 = level1_parent[parent2]
        if parent1 not in level1_labels:
            level1_labels.append(parent1)

    df.loc[idx, "CLASS_LEVEL_1"] = " | ".join(level1_labels)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HANDLE RECORDS WITH NO LEVEL3 MATCH AT ALL
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

no_match_mask = df["CLASS_LEVEL_3_A"] == ""

df.loc[no_match_mask, "CLASS_LEVEL_3_A"] = "Undetermined"
df.loc[no_match_mask, "CLASS_LEVEL_2_A"] = "Undetermined"
df.loc[no_match_mask, "CLASS_LEVEL_1"] = "Undetermined"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DERIVE BOOLEAN FLAGS FROM THE CLASS COLUMNS (single source of truth --
# these are no longer computed by a separate keyword pass, so they can't
# drift out of sync with CLASS_LEVEL_1/2/3)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

level3_combined = (
    df["CLASS_LEVEL_3_A"].fillna("") + " | " + df["CLASS_LEVEL_3_B"].fillna("")
)
level2_combined = (
    df["CLASS_LEVEL_2_A"].fillna("") + " | " + df["CLASS_LEVEL_2_B"].fillna("")
)


def _contains_label(combined_col, label):
    return combined_col.apply(
        lambda x: label in [s.strip() for s in x.split("|")]
    )


level3_flags = [
    "COLD", "HEAT", "OVERDOSE", "SUICIDE", "HOMICIDE", "CARDIOVASCULAR",
    "RESPIRATORY", "CANCER", "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC", "COVID", "COMM_DISEASE",
    "NON_COMM_DISEASE", "ACCIDENTAL", "DIGESTIVE", "GENITOUTINARY", "ENDROCRINE, NUTRITIONAL, AND METABOLIC DISEASE"
}
]

for flag in level3_flags:
    df[flag] = _contains_label(level3_combined, class3_labels[flag])

level2_flag_map = {
    "Accidental": "ACCIDENTAL",
    "Intentional": "INTENTIONAL",
    "Communicable Disease": "COMM_DISEASE",
    "Non-Communicable Disease": "NON_COMM_DISEASE",
}

for label, flag in level2_flag_map.items():
    df[flag] = _contains_label(level2_combined, label)

df["EXTERNAL"] = df["CLASS_LEVEL_1"].str.contains(
    "External/Injury (Unnatural Death)", regex=False
)
df["INTERNAL"] = df["CLASS_LEVEL_1"].str.contains(
    "Internal (Natural Death)", regex=False
)
df["UNDETERMINED"] = df["CLASS_LEVEL_1"] == "Undetermined"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL COLUMN ORDER
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

final_column_order = [
    "CASE_NUMBER", "CAUSE",
    "MATCH_COUNT", "MATCHED_KEYWORDS", "MATCHED_KEYWORD", "MATCH_SCORE", "MATCH_TYPE",
    "EXTERNAL", "INTERNAL", "UNDETERMINED",
    "ACCIDENTAL", "INTENTIONAL", "COMM_DISEASE", "NON_COMM_DISEASE",
    "COLD", "HEAT", "OVERDOSE", "SUICIDE", "HOMICIDE", "COVID",
    "CARDIOVASCULAR", "RESPIRATORY", "CANCER", "NEUROPSYCHIATRIC", "DIGESTIVE",
    "GENITOUTINARY",
    "ENDROCRINE, NUTRITIONAL, AND METABOLIC DISEASE"
}
    "LEVEL2_GROUP_COUNT", "LEVEL2_OVERFLOW",
    "CLASS_LEVEL_1",
    "CLASS_LEVEL_2_A", "CLASS_LEVEL_3_A",
    "CLASS_LEVEL_2_B", "CLASS_LEVEL_3_B",
]

remaining = [c for c in df.columns if c not in final_column_order]
df = df[final_column_order + remaining]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EXPORT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

df.to_excel(
    "code/cod_algorithm_extras/b_01_full_results_ICD.xlsx",
    index=False
)


```

# Pulling random sample 1
```{r randomtests}

# Load data
df <- readRDS("data/hcmd.rds")

# Registry of previously sampled cases
registry <- "code/cod_algorithm_extras/used_review_ids.csv"

used_ids <- if (file.exists(registry)) {
  read.csv(registry)$case_number
} else {
  character(0)
}

# Eligible records: nonblank cause + not previously sampled
eligible <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cause),
    trimws(cause) != "",
    !case_number %in% used_ids
  )

# Number of states
n_states <- n_distinct(eligible$state_abbrev)

# Sample as evenly as possible across states
set.seed(1)

round1 <- eligible %>%
  group_by(state_abbrev) %>%
  group_modify(~ slice_sample(.x, n = min(floor(50 / n_states), nrow(.x)))) %>%
  ungroup()

# If fewer than 50 were sampled because some states had too few records,
# randomly add additional eligible records
if (nrow(round1) < 50) {
  
  remaining <- eligible %>%
    filter(!case_number %in% round1$case_number)
  
  round1 <- bind_rows(
    round1,
    slice_sample(remaining, n = min(50 - nrow(round1), nrow(remaining)))
  )
}

# Save sample
write.csv(
  round1,
  "code/cod_algorithm_extras/review_round1_sample.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Update registry
write.csv(
  data.frame(
    case_number = unique(c(used_ids, round1$case_number))
  ),
  registry,
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

# Pulling round 3 (final) sample
```{r randomtests_round3}

library(dplyr)

# Load data
df <- readRDS("data/hcmd.rds")

# Registry of previously sampled cases
registry <- "code/cod_algorithm_extras/used_review_ids.csv"

used_ids <- if (file.exists(registry)) {
  read.csv(registry)$case_number
} else {
  character(0)
}

# Eligible records:
# - nonblank cause
# - not previously sampled in rounds 1 or 2
eligible <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cause),
    trimws(cause) != "",
    !case_number %in% used_ids
  )

# Total final sample size
sample_size <- 1000

# Calculate the number of eligible records in each state
state_counts <- eligible %>%
  count(state_abbrev, name = "state_n") %>%
  mutate(
    state_proportion = state_n / sum(state_n),
    exact_n = state_proportion * sample_size,
    sample_n = floor(exact_n),
    remainder = exact_n - sample_n
  )

# Distribute remaining sample slots to states with the largest remainders
remaining_slots <- sample_size - sum(state_counts$sample_n)

if (remaining_slots > 0) {
  state_counts <- state_counts %>%
    arrange(desc(remainder)) %>%
    mutate(
      sample_n = sample_n + if_else(row_number() <= remaining_slots, 1L, 0L)
    ) %>%
    arrange(state_abbrev)
}

# Check that the state allocations sum to exactly 1,000
stopifnot(sum(state_counts$sample_n) == sample_size)

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(3)

# Draw the proportional sample within each state
round3 <- eligible %>%
  inner_join(
    state_counts %>% select(state_abbrev, sample_n),
    by = "state_abbrev"
  ) %>%
  group_by(state_abbrev) %>%
  group_modify(~ slice_sample(.x, n = unique(.x$sample_n))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-sample_n)

# Final checks
stopifnot(nrow(round3) == sample_size)
stopifnot(!any(round3$case_number %in% used_ids))

# Save sample
write.csv(
  round3,
  "code/cod_algorithm_extras/review_round3_sample.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Update registry
write.csv(
  data.frame(
    case_number = unique(c(used_ids, round3$case_number))
  ),
  registry,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

#checking round files 
```{r roundid}
library(dplyr)

registry <- "code/cod_algorithm_extras/used_review_ids.csv"

# Back up the current registry first
file.copy(registry, sub("\\.csv$", "_backup.csv", registry), overwrite = TRUE)

round_files <- c(
  "code/cod_algorithm_extras/review_round1_sample.csv",
  "code/cod_algorithm_extras/review_round2_sample.csv",
  "code/cod_algorithm_extras/review_round3_sample.csv"
)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(round_files)))

# Rebuild from what was actually sampled (rounds 1-3 only, not round 4)
rebuilt <- bind_rows(lapply(round_files, function(f) {
  read.csv(f, colClasses = "character") %>% select(case_number)
})) %>%
  distinct()

nrow(rebuilt)   # expect about 1,100 (50 + 50 + 1000)

# See how many extra ids were in the old registry
old <- read.csv(sub("\\.csv$", "_backup.csv", registry), colClasses = "character")
length(setdiff(old$case_number, rebuilt$case_number))

write.csv(rebuilt, registry, row.names = FALSE)
```
